prompts.ID: This is a crop of an event venue floor plan, drawn from above. What single object is at the centre of the image? Answer with exactly one word from: table, chair, sofa, bench, banquette, column, stage, bar, entrance, lodge, nothing.
prompts.COUNT: This is a crop of an event venue floor plan, drawn from above. How many tables are in the image? Count only tables, not chairs, sofas or benches. Answer with a number only.
prompts.CHAIRS: This is a crop of an event venue floor plan, drawn from above. How many chairs stand around the table in the centre? Answer with a number only.
prompts.MERGED: This is a crop of an event venue floor plan, drawn from above. Do the tables in the centre touch each other to form one long table? Answer yes or no.
prompts.SERVES: This is a crop of an event venue floor plan, drawn from above. Does the {piece} stand directly against the table so people on it sit at that table? Answer yes or no.
